Why does follow-up after an abnormal screening matter?

Screening only helps if the woman returns for evaluation. CerviSetu tracks each abnormal finding from the health post through colposcopy, biopsy and treatment, so a missed step is noticed and followed up.
How does the platform protect patient identity?
Names, phone numbers and addresses are kept in an AES 256 GCM encrypted vault. AI services receive masked text and coded patient tokens instead of identifying details.
How does a referral reach the right hospital?

Each health post is linked to its referral hospital. For example, Dharavi Urban Health Centre refers to Sion Hospital, and Parel or Naigaon health posts refer to KEM Hospital. Administrators keep the hospital list and its services up to date.
What happens if a patient does not respond after referral?

For the first ten days she receives daily reminders by voice, WhatsApp or SMS. Contact becomes more intensive over the next three days. On day fourteen a community health worker visits her home and records her decision.
No. CerviSetu is a data collection and coordination tool. Histopathology confirms a tissue diagnosis, clinicians make every decision, and a referral never waits for AI output.
Does the system require expensive hardware?
No. It runs in a modern web browser on existing computers, tablets and phones.
